The trace shows that the app had already ended the session itself, because My Work's paged work-items load (more than 200 items by then) was still running when the test logged out elsewhere. The test passed in the unset run (26.3 s en, 15.0 s ar), in C.UTF-8 ar, and alone in C.UTF-8 (16/16). The guard was then restricted to low-disk conditions and never pruned again. In the C.UTF-8 run, p4-benefits test 8 (23.6 s / 15.4 s) and session-end (5.6 s / 5.5 s) passed in both projects. So every one of the 470 product tests passed on this candidate in each project, in at least one full run or its solo re-run. The other 467 passed in both full runs. All the axe assertions in passing tests held, with 0 serious or critical issues. I judge the product behaviour verified.
